GRACE_SETTINGS.becomes: spec/app/preferences.md preview, save and undo, through spec/app/workspace.md changePreferences

GRACE_BROWSER.becomes: spec/app/workspace.md changePage, with the browserControls.md input Navigate, Back, Forward, Reload or NewTab

GRACE_CALENDAR.becomes: spec/app/calendarView.md createOccurrence or changeOccurrence, confirmAppointment after her yes, changeOccurrence CancelEditing after her no, requestDeletion and approveDeletion with her scope after her yes, and changeOccurrence DismissReminder

GRACE_EMAIL.becomes: spec/app/email.md readMail, chooseFolder, startDraft and editDraft, and changeSelectedMessage; sending stays hers

GRACE_TASK.becomes: spec/app/workspace.md begin, and the task's fill only after her yes to the chosen terms

allow.REPLY: Her words back to the person: text, an optional working sentence, whether it is a question and its two or three answers. It changes nothing.
allow.IGNORE: Ends a turn that needs no answer. It changes nothing.
allow.NONE: Ends a turn that needs no action. It changes nothing.
